correctness.rationale: The Rayleigh quotient and traceless characteristic cubic give the exact width; Haar azimuthal conditioning proves the integral CDF. Eight isolated conical minima give coefficient 12; the two singular endpoint models are integrated explicitly and matched against the interior, yielding \(\frac{6q}{\pi}[\log(1/q)+1]+o(q)\), hence the sharp square-root-log coefficient and second constant. A separate regular-zero-set bound establishes conditional six-axis localization. Actual standalone numerical verification passes 2,577 deterministic assertions.
